title: Liu v. Kaiser Permanente Employees Pension Plan for the Permanente Medical Group, Inc.
summary: The Ninth Circuit issued a published opinion in Liu v. Kaiser Permanente Employees Pension Plan, an ERISA benefits dispute appealed from a district court in the circuit. The opinion addresses the plan's benefit determination and the standard applied on review.

matches.reason: An ERISA pension benefits appeal; the fhw charter covers federal health and welfare regulation, not pension litigation.
Single-employer pension plan; no multiemployer or Taft-Hartley issue is stated.
A published Ninth Circuit ERISA opinion on benefit claims and the standard of review falls squarely within the ca9 charter.
